In normalized coordinates of the square metal body, origin top-left: ATX motherboard region is x=4.65% to57.90%, y=3.49% to74.42%. This is a 229 by305mm board; do NOT draw the board, only empty flat steel tray and small standoffs. The PSU section occupies the bottom 100mm, 23.26% of body height. The separator rail is at y=76.74%, below the ATX board's bottom, never across the board. Empty lower-left PSU bay can fit 180mm depth by86mm height, from x1.86% to43.72%, y79.07% to99.07%. Rear seven expansion slot edges occupy lower half of motherboard chamber; empty rear fan mount upper-left visible only as a thin edge. Cable-routing openings to the right of tray stay outside the marked board region. No installed board/CPU/RAM/GPU/PSU/cooler/drives/fans, no shroud, cables, sideglass, measurements, labels, dimension guides or typography in finished art. Neutral white upper-left studio light, soft fill, no glow. True transparent alpha around all edges and through empty PSU bay if appropriate, generous padding. Do not bake a floor or outside shadow.
